This implies that Ipomine A may exert its biological effects via the activation of 10(14)-Cadinene-4,5-diol, which in turn influences the activity of Solute carrier organic anion transporter family member 1B3. The final score of 0.5606 suggests a moderate level of confidence in this relationship, though further experimental validation would be necessary to confirm the direct interaction between Ipomine A and the transporter. The mechanism appears to involve a signaling cascade where Ipomine A modulates the activity of a downstream compound, which then affects the transporter.
